prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 合规审查法律条文引用表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "法律名称" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 261px
  col 2: header "条款" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 3: header "条文内容" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 4732px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇集合规审查所依据的法律、条款编号及条文内容，便于核对法律依据。","reading":"读者先按法律名称和条款编号定位，再横向阅读对应条文；比较时可沿法律名称或条文内容纵向扫描。条文较长，形成的行高可容纳法律名称适度换行。","groups":["法律名称与条款共同构成引用定位信息，应在同一行中容易关联。","条文内容是对应的法律依据，承担主要阅读任务，需要最多的横向空间。"],"keep_intact":["条款编号尽量保持单行，避免影响定位。","法律名称中的专名和书名号应保持清晰，尽量避免不自然的断开。"],"may_wrap":["条文内容可按中文自然换行。","较长的法律名称可适度换行，利用条文带来的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [282, 144, 293] · table 720×1882px · row heights [36, 455, 222, 246, 362, 292, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 19 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [190, 144, 385] · table 720×1441px · row heights [36, 339, 176, 176, 292, 222, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [145, 105, 469] · table 720×1185px · row heights [36, 269, 153, 153, 222, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"法律名称和条款编号均保持单行，定位信息清楚；表头也完整显示。","problems":"条文列过窄，正文频繁换行，行高很大；左侧两列留下大片空白，阅读和跨行查找都较费力。","cause":"法律名称列282px足以容纳最长名称，条款列144px也刚好容纳最长编号，但两者合计占去426px，条文列只剩293px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"条文列明显拓宽，正文段落和行高更易阅读；条款编号保持单行，三列表头完整。","problems":"多个法律名称在专名中间断行，例如“民法典”被拆开，末行有时很短；条款列下方仍有较多空白。","cause":"法律名称列190px不足以容纳完整名称，且当前断行位置不利于保留专名；条款列144px按最长编号配置，短编号占用的空间较少。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"条文列宽469px，正文阅读较从容，行高缩短，列的主次关系清楚。","problems":"最长条款编号被拆成两行，影响引用定位；法律名称普遍换行，最长名称占三行，左侧信息的扫描节奏受到影响。","cause":"条款列105px的文本空间只有84px，容不下123px的最长编号；法律名称列145px也过窄。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[175,144,400],"change":"以r0B为基础，保留足以让最长条款编号单行显示的144px；法律名称列收至175px，观察是否能形成更清楚的两行断法，并将15px让给条文。"},{"name":"text-first","widths":[145,144,430],"change":"以r0C为基础，将条款列加宽至144px，恢复最长编号单行；法律名称仍用145px，接受名称换行，保留较宽的条文阅读区。"},{"name":"name-first","widths":[205,144,370],"change":"将法律名称列加宽至205px，尝试改善r0B中专名和短末行的断法；条款列保持144px，条文列仍比r0A宽77px。"}]}
